note: City of West Point campground in Neligh Park (despite the name, it's in West Point, not the town of Neligh): a fan of concrete pads at the park's south edge off W Bridge St, open lawn, few trees. Small park lake, ballfields, pool and dog park nearby; the Elkhorn River is ~0.3 mi west through woods. Site water is shut off in winter. Tents next to the dog park. --Claude
